title: Test Architect
description:
##### **Project description**

We are seeking an experienced Test Architect to lead the end\-to\-end test strategy across the domain, embedding quality early in the software development lifecycle through shift\-left practices and leveraging AI to enhance and accelerate testing outcomes. This senior engineering leadership role requires the successful candidate to serve as the technical authority on test automation, quality engineering, and test strategy, establishing standards for designing, measuring, and delivering quality across teams.


##### **Responsibilities**


Define and own the domain\-wide test strategy covering functional, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing, ensuring alignment with business objectives, engineering practices, and release goals.


Drive shift\-left quality practices by embedding testing into design and development phases to detect, prevent, and resolve defects early, reducing change costs and delivery risks.


Lead the adoption and application of AI throughout the test lifecycle, including AI\-assisted test generation, coverage analysis, specification\-driven test development, automated code review, and intelligent test prioritization.


Establish and enforce standards for test automation frameworks, tooling selection, reusable test assets, and test data strategy to ensure consistency, maintainability, and scalability across the domain.


Implement and maintain quality gates, coverage targets, and measurable test\-effectiveness metrics, such as defect escape rate, test cycle time, and automation coverage, to provide clear visibility into quality status.


Coach and mentor engineers and test specialists across teams, enhancing test engineering capabilities and serving as the technical escalation point for complex quality issues.


Collaborate with architecture leads, delivery leads, and product owners to align testing approaches with CI/CD pipelines, engineering standards, and release schedules.


Continuously assess and adapt the test strategy in response to technology developments, platform changes, and emerging best practices in quality engineering and AI\-assisted development.


##### **Skills**


Must have


The role requires extensive expertise in test automation, quality engineering, and test architecture, gained through over 15 years of hands\-on experience at an enterprise scale. The candidate should have a strong background in designing and implementing shift\-left testing strategies that integrate quality controls into continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines.


Hard skills include proficiency with test automation frameworks, specifically Selenium and Playwright, applied to both API and UI testing. The candidate must demonstrate practical experience in utilizing AI and generative AI technologies to enhance engineering and testing workflows, such as AI\-assisted test case creation, specification\-driven testing, intelligent coverage analysis, and automated test review. Additionally, expertise is expected in managing test data strategies, test environments, and service virtualization within complex, multi\-system architectures. The role also involves defining and managing quality gates, coverage metrics, and test\-effectiveness KPIs within agile and DevOps frameworks.


Soft skills entail strong technical leadership capabilities, with proven ability to influence and align engineering, delivery, and architecture teams without direct authority. Effective communication skills are essential for articulating testing strategies, risks, and trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


Extensive experience in enterprise\-scale test automation and quality engineering


Design and implementation of shift\-left testing in CI/CD pipelines


Application of AI and generative AI in testing workflows


Expertise in Selenium and Playwright for API and UI automation


Management of test data, environments, and service virtualization in complex systems


Definition and operation of quality gates, metrics, and KPIs in agile/DevOps contexts


Proven technical leadership influencing cross\-functional teams


Clear communication of technical strategies and risk management to diverse audiences

title: R&D IC Engineer 5
description:

Our award\-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry\-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.  

We are looking for a hands\-on FPGA Architect to architect, design, develop, and debug next\-generation CXL and PCIe Gen6/Gen7 protocol solutions. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role in a small team. The architect will define FPGA architecture while also writing RTL, implementing features, debugging designs, and supporting hardware/software integration and platform bring\-up.
Responsibilities:
* Define and own FPGA architecture for CXL\- and PCIe\-based protocol solutions, with CXL as the primary focus.
* Translate CXL and PCIe Gen6/Gen7 protocol and product requirements into scalable FPGA architectures and implementation plans.
* Personally design, code, simulate, review, and debug production RTL in Verilog and/or VHDL.
* Work hands\-on with Intel/Altera and/or AMD/Xilinx FPGA tools for synthesis, implementation, constraints, timing closure, and resource optimization.
* Develop and execute simulation and verification for FPGA designs using industry\-standard EDA tools.
* Drive FPGA integration with hardware and software and support platform bring\-up, debug, and system validation.
* Analyze complex protocol, performance, interoperability, and system issues and drive root\-cause resolution.
* Collaborate closely with hardware, software, validation, system, product, and global engineering teams.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to architecture, design, and code reviews while remaining a hands\-on implementer.
* Use AI/ML and AI\-assisted engineering tools to improve RTL development, verification, debugging, documentation, automation, and engineering productivity.


Qualifications:
**Essential*** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or related field.
* 8\+ years of FPGA architecture, design, and development experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience with CXL and/or PCIe protocols.
* Strong experience with Verilog/VHDL and RTL design.
* Experience with Intel/Altera and/or AMD/Xilinx FPGA tools and design flows.
* Experience with functional simulation, FPGA debug, synthesis, and timing analysis.
* Experience integrating FPGA with hardware and software.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to quickly learn new technologies and protocols.

**Preferred*** Strong experience with PCIe Gen6/Gen7 and CXL.
* Experience with protocol analyzers, exercisers, validation platforms, oscilloscopes, BERTs, or related high\-speed test equipment.
* Experience with FPGA\-based high\-speed test systems and hardware bring\-up.
* Exposure to NVMe, storage systems, or data\-center interconnect technologies.
* Experience using AI/ML or GenAI tools to improve engineering productivity and automation.
* Experience working with global engineering teams across the US, Europe, and Asia.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================


Defines a robust CXL\-first FPGA architecture and personally delivers critical RTL/features; enables clean hardware/software integration and platform bring\-up; and raises team capability through technical leadership, mentoring, and hands\-on resolution of difficult system issues.

title: Senior Revit Architect
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

**Revit / BIM Architect:**  

Role Overview
  
With a diverse and talented platform of over 1000 designers worldwide, and thousands of projects designed every year
  
for many Fortune500 firms, JLL’s ambition is to be the leader in design. As a company with a strong focus in technology,
  
we are constantly bringing together the latest innovation to enable our clients to benefit from our design technology, from
  
inception to completion for the best possible experience and outcome for their projects.
  
With that in mind, we’re looking for a Revit Technician, who can work with our regional team to produce and deliver
  
projects in BIM for our APAC design studios. If you have a background in industry working with BIM, and have a passion
  
for error\-free, high quality technical documentation, this can be a good opportunity to realize your ambition.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

* Produce detailed plans, sections, elevations, details, schedules and all required elements of design and


construction documentation for office interior fit outs in Revit.
  
* Create Revit models for entire projects, utilizing reference CAD backgrounds and SketchUp models as a basis.
* Ensure company Revit drawing standards are properly implemented as required in all sets.
* Day\-to\-day project coordination efforts with the ability to prioritize deadlines.
* Work with project representatives regularly to meet overall project objectives.
* Strong knowledge in content creation and parametric properties of families.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to Revit software, ensuring smooth workflow, and


minimizing disruptions.
  
* Perform quality control checks on Revit models and drawings, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and adherence to


project requirements.
  
* Work on projects from inception to completion with the project team members.
* Stay updated on the latest developments and trends in Revit software and related technologies and share


knowledge and best practices with the team.
  
* Deliver medium to large\-scale workplace projects.


**Experience:**  

* Qualified professional in Design, Architecture or related discipline or field with at least 2 years of experience in a


BIM / Revit role working in medium to large scale corporate office projects.
  
* Proficiency in Revit modelling and the ability to model quickly.
* Strong technical background and expertise in Autodesk Revit Architecture, AutoCAD software, BIM360, Revit


family creation and modelling.
  
* Has a good understanding of the built digital environment and how ideas can be modelled and realized.
* A strong level understanding of how a design project can be translated into the BIM environment.
* Excellent English communication skills.


**Values \& Traits:**  

* Personal values that align with JLL’s values of teamwork, ethics, excellence.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, team collaboration skills essential for team\-based working.
* A problem solver by nature.
* Somebody who is known for getting things done.


.
  
  

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Data Solution Architect
description:
##### **Project description**

We are seeking a Data Solution Architect to design and implement scalable, cloud\-native data solutions across both OLAP (analytical) and OLTP (operational) architectures, applying advanced data management and governance practices within a large\-scale banking environment. This role provides technical leadership on modern data platforms — spanning Data Lakes, Operational Data Stores, real\-time streaming, and Data Mesh — ensuring solutions are secure, performant, cost\-optimised, and aligned with enterprise data strategy. The successful candidate will combine deep data engineering expertise with architectural vision, working across business, data engineering, and analytics teams to deliver data solutions that support both operational excellence and advanced analytics use cases.


##### **Responsibilities**

Capture and articulate business objectives, strategic drivers, and domain\-specific requirements to inform the target architectural vision.


Define the target architectural strategy for Trade Finance aligned with the organization’s overall business and technology strategies and enterprise architecture guidelines.


Ensure the strategy addresses Trade Finance domain specifics—such as documentary credits, guarantees, collections, supply chain finance, and compliance—and integration with Payments and Core Banking platforms.


Align the strategy with modern architecture principles, including cloud\-native design, API\-first, event\-driven patterns, and data\-centric approaches, while managing legacy system migration challenges.


Define the target solution architecture covering business, application, data, and technology domains.


Design end\-to\-end architectural views and process flows for the full Trade Finance scope, including integration patterns with Payments, Core Banking, regulatory reporting, and external messaging systems.


Develop high\-level design artifacts that clearly communicate the solution to technical teams and business stakeholders.


Document and assess transformation roadmap options for Trade Finance, evaluating feasibility, risk, time\-to\-value, and organizational impact.


Define the recommended end\-to\-end roadmap, outlining capability sequencing, migration phases, and key milestones.


Produce a high\-level implementation roadmap detailing impacts on related domains, dependencies, risks, and assumptions, and secure approval from relevant stakeholders including business leadership, enterprise architecture, domain leads, and delivery teams.

Proficiency in cloud\-native architectures, microservices design patterns, REST and event\-driven API design, contract\-first approaches, and various database models including relational, NoSQL, and event sourcing.

Development of architectural artifacts such as solution architecture documentation, high\-level designs, integration views, data flow diagrams, roadmaps, and options analyses.


Soft skills include:


Effective collaboration with diverse stakeholders across functions, domains, and regions.


Strong communication, facilitation, and negotiation abilities to achieve alignment and secure architectural approvals.


Comfort working in ambiguous environments, translating incomplete business requirements into structured architectural options with well\-defined trade\-offs.
